title: Kingshot hero gear stat lookup for simulator injection
simulator_stat_units: percentage points added to hero.stats for the matching battle side and hero troop type
notes: Hero gear is configured separately for attacker and defender.
The attacker and defender values are currently identical max-gear values and can be changed independently later.
When ADD_HERO_GEAR_ATK/DEF is True, these values are applied to every verified hero profile according to battle side and hero troop type.
Prepared hero stats are rebuilt from lookup values, so gear is never accumulated repeatedly onto an already prepared JSON.
inf = Infantry, lanc = Cavalry, mark = Archers.
